MISSION HAMMER AT PETROPAVLOVSK
SITUATION OPAREA: Petropavlovsk approaches. An offshore ASW command and replenishment group supports the bastion defense.
MISSION Ambush the offshore ASW command and replenishment group, then withdraw.
EXECUTION Approach under cover, strike the ASW command and replenishment group, then withdraw before the screen reacts.
RULES OF ENGAGEMENT Tomahawk land attack is authorized against designated facilities. Conserve heavyweight torpedoes.
FRIENDLY FORCES USS Los Angeles is the flagship and must survive. USS Drum and USS San Francisco are assigned; their losses do not end the operation.
SUPPORT No surface or air unit is under player control. Manage weapons and damage for the next patrol.
